t: You are in Manchester Square, a small Georgian garden square in Marylebone, just north of Oxford Street. Building began around 1776, and many of the houses are now listed. On the north side stands Hertford House, first called Manchester House. Since 1897 it has housed the Wallace Collection of fine and decorative arts. Two people connected to the square died here. Sir Algernon West was a civil servant who served as Principal Private Secretary to Prime Minister William Gladstone. Charlotte Adams wrote children's books.
